required_outcomes: Tells the tenant promptly that Keystone Compliance cannot attend on Monday 8 September, so she does not wait in or book time off for it.
Offers her Keystone's two alternatives, Thursday 11 September 10am to 12pm or Friday 12 September 1pm to 4pm, and asks which she can do (or for other availability).
Lets Keystone know the tenant is being asked and that her choice will follow, and keeps a dated follow-up to settle the new date.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking Keystone for an earlier slot as well, since the oven has been out of action since before 26 August.
Phoning the tenant instead of emailing, with the call logged.
positive_behaviours: Apologises to the tenant for a second change of date.
Updates the job record so 8 September is no longer shown as the appointment.
red_flags: Leaving the job on hold with 8 September still recorded as the visit.
Escalating a routine rescheduling to a human.
prohibited_actions: Booking Thursday 11 or Friday 12 September (set_visit) before the tenant has agreed to it.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant the visit is still on Monday 8 September, or that a new date is confirmed when she has not agreed one.
